reviews.review: As a more mature player, I have played many many games on and off line since the late 80's but the Sniper Elite series are amongst the best there is. I have read many letters saying that Resistance is poor, buggy and not up to par...They are wrong. Yes there are bugs, but what game in the past 40 years havn't had their share?
LOVE ALL THE SNIPER ELITE GAMES & LOVE PLAYING AS HARRY HAWKER...I LIKE KARL BUT HE DOESN'T HAVE MUCH OF A PERSONALITY LIKE HAWKER DOES
It's just more of Sniper Elite 4 and 5.  Expect the same thing.

Its a lot of fun, if you are into the series or a newbie I think you would like it! my only gripe is that it honestly feels like a slightly worse version of five, with similar maps, missions, and even story. But still an excellent game that I recommend. to me SE5 is a 8/10 so I would put this closer to a 7/10.

This is a real hard one to give a down vote on.

I'm not going to make the argument that this game is just SE5 DLC. That's not the game's biggest problem.

For context, my friend and I play this on either Sniper Elite difficulty or Authentic. Despite that, something about the game felt easier than previous entries. It wasn't until I saw it mentioned in another review that I realized it.

Enemy spawn placement is sparse. In previous games, enemy patrols and general awareness was high enough that we always had to plan out our attack angles and cover our backs. In this one, each grouping of enemies felt more like a separated silo. If you caused chaos at one location, it would stay there and there was little threat of an enemy patrol from the outside coming in the spoil your fun.

Despite being on Sniper Elite mode, we were able to basically stomp around like rambo and throw caution to the wind. If we stuck to just sniping, there were a few maps where we were able to literally clear out the entire zone of hostiles from right next to the default starting location. Because enemy groups were so sparse, there was rarely a situation where we felt like we could get overwhelmed.

The game plays like a SE game without question. In terms of mechanics and general gameplay, it's fine. Outside of what I said above, it feels like its worse sin is not doing anything that hasn't been done in previous games. I honestly think that's the reason so many have said that this just feels like a SE5 DLC game. Frankly, if that was its biggest issue, I'd be recommending it.

However, the sparse enemy grouping is just inescapable. And, to be frank, I'm not sure if that is the specific thing we were encountering. Maybe the enemy AI is just not responsive enough or maybe the maps weren't designed with enough consideration towards how far the player can snipe. Whatever the case, SOMETHING about engaging with the enemy has just ended up feeling lackluster.

This is something that could be patched in some way, but that seems unlikely at this stage.

If you like SE5 a lot, you will like this one. Yes it reuses content, yes it could have been a bigger expansion or two, yes the main character is idiotic (although you can play as Karl skin (that helps)), although idk what is happening but french resistance looks like african resistance for some reason (it would have been cool if this was in SE3, not in France, and vice versa). If you can live with those things (and they are not as anoying as many people put them out to be), the game will be fun, if you did not like a lot SE5 or the story, or the gameplay, or the maps ... you wont like this one.


I liked it. with some workarounds.

Have enjoyed this series of games for a long time. In this one, the game play was just as fun until I got to Mission 5. Devil's Cauldron. It has turned into a crash fest. I'm running as Admin, have verified game files, updated GPU drivers, all background apps closed, borderless window is set and quality has been set to everything from Ultra to medium. NOTHING fixes it. I've checked diagnostics and event viewer, nothing  is helping. Sent multiple crash reports. The game is now unplayable. Glad I got it on sale, but even half price is too much money for a game I only get a few hours out of and cannot finish due to crashing.

Game is clearly rushed and full of small errors that build up to a large fiasco. 
The game itself is honestly good and the gameplay works really well, it's just such a large amount of errors and issues and lack of polish that makes this NOT a good buy unless it's on a hefty sale.
